annotations.title: Wallet portfolio, history, compliance & PnL audit

description: [$0.04] Trigger When: auditing wallet history, multi-asset portfolio USD value, or agent readiness. Workflow Outcome: aggregates ETH/WETH/USDC portfolio, nonce history, top counterparties, taint, and PnL. Do not use for DeFi borrow liquidation checks (use defi_position_shield) or protocol TVL checks (use defi_protocol_tvl_check). `lookback_blocks` is clamped to `100-2000` (default `1000`) to keep `eth_getLogs` fast across public RPCs. Live RPC/log scan, read-only non-custodial; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

lookback_blocks.description: Recent block window for USDC Transfer logs (100-2000)
